function.name: read_docs
function.description: Read the store's reference documents at SECTION granularity. Call with only `doc` to get the table of contents (section slugs); call again with `section` to read that section. 'policy' holds the rules (what may / may not be done); 'workflow' holds operating procedures and domain reference. Consult the relevant policy section before any write action or refusal.

section.description: Section slug from the table of contents, e.g. 'cancellation'. Omit to list sections.

function.name: find_user_id_by_name_zip
function.description: Find user id by first name, last name, and zip code. Returns an error message if not found.

function.name: get_user_details
function.description: Get the details of a user, including their orders, addresses, and payment methods.

function.name: get_order_details
function.description: Get the status, items, and payment history of an order.

order_id.description: The order id, e.g. '#W0000000'. Note the leading '#'.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Get the variants (item ids, options, availability, price) of a product.

product_id.description: The product id, e.g. '9523456873'. This is not the item id.

function.name: cancel_pending_order
function.description: Cancel an order. See the policy and workflow documents for the rules and procedure.

reason.description: Cancellation reason (see policy for valid values).

function.name: place_order
function.description: Place a new order for a user. Payment rules: if the payment method is a gift card, its balance must cover the total; when it does not, a non-gift-card fallback payment method is required — the gift card is drained and the remainder is charged to the fallback. Without a fallback, an order exceeding the gift card balance is rejected. Requires explicit user confirmation before calling.

item_ids.description: Catalog item ids (variants) to order, e.g. '1008292230'.

fallback_payment_method_id.description: Optional non-gift-card method charged for the remainder when a gift card cannot cover the total.

function.name: modify_pending_order_items
function.description: Modify items of a pending order to other variants of the same products. See the policy and workflow documents for the rules and procedure.

item_ids.description: The current item ids to change.

new_item_ids.description: The replacement item ids, same length/order as item_ids.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method for settling the price difference.

function.name: return_delivered_order_items
function.description: Return items of an order. See the policy and workflow documents for the rules, fees, windows, and procedure.

reason.description: Return reason (see policy for valid values).

function.name: exchange_delivered_order_items
function.description: Exchange items of an order for other variants of the same products. See the policy and workflow documents for the rules and procedure.

item_ids.description: The item ids to exchange away.

new_item_ids.description: The replacement item ids, same length/order as item_ids.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method for settling the price difference.

function.name: finish
function.description: Submit the outcome and end the episode: finish(answer=...) for a question, finish(decision="refuse", reason="<code>") to decline the request, finish() after a completed action task. Call it exactly once, as the only call of its turn.

answer.description: Your final answer to the customer's question — a number, a string, or a list of strings. Omit for action tasks.

decision.description: Set to "refuse" to decline the request instead of carrying it out.
